newsitem.title: UK: BMW to invest 3 bln stg in Rover - paper.
newsitem.headline: BMW to invest 3 bln stg in Rover - paper.

text.p: German car maker BMW plans to invest a total three billion stg in Britain's Rover Group and revamp the unit's product range over the next 10 years, the Independent newspaper reported on Thursday.
As part of the overhaul, BMW wants to raise Rover's production by half to about 750,000 cars a year, the paper added, citing Rover's chief executive Walter Hasselkus.
Hasselkus took up his current post at loss-making Rover on September 1.
Parent company BMW had already announced investments of 1.5 billion stg in Rover. It will spend the same amount again from the year 2000, the Independent said.
Hasselkus repeated that Rover won't be profitable until 2000, the newspaper said.
Rover's production increase will likely be accompanied by the building of a 500 million stg engine plant in the mid-west of England, it added.
